_readme: Register of ACCEPTED NuGet vulnerabilities. Empty means nothing is accepted: every high/critical finding blocks CI.
Enforced by .github/scripts/check-nuget-audit.py. One entry = one advisory + one package + one exact version + one project (.csproj).
Required: advisory (GHSA id), package, version, project, owner, issue (#123 or /issues/123 URL), reason, granted, expires (YYYY-MM-DD, max 60 days after granted).
A matching <NuGetAuditSuppress Include="https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-..." /> goes in THAT project's own .csproj, nowhere else.
An entry that matches no current finding fails the gate, so fixed exceptions cannot linger. An entry past 'expires' fails the gate.
Adding an entry needs the founder's explicit approval in the PR; development dependencies get no category exemption.
